periods.time: During the 11th-floor rest after the first party battle

name.zh: 贝尔首次发动【英雄愿望】击倒幼龙
name.en: Bell First Activates Argonaut Against an Infant Dragon

periods.summary: While thinking about heroic longing and the origin of his new skill, Bell's right hand gathers white light and bell-like sounds. An Infant Dragon appears and charges toward Lili; Bell fires Firebolt through the charged hand, producing an enormous white-laced flame lightning blast that pierces the dragon and scars the dungeon wall.
periods.cause: Bell's reflection on wanting to become a hero triggers Heroic Desire / Argonaut, and the Infant Dragon threatens Lili before he understands the skill.
periods.process: White particles gather around Bell's right hand. The rare Infant Dragon disrupts the chamber, knocks out an elf adventurer, and charges toward Lili. Bell instinctively extends the glowing hand and casts Firebolt, amplifying it into a massive blast.
periods.outcome: The Infant Dragon is defeated instantly, Lili is saved, nearby adventurers stare at Bell in shock and hostility, and Bell realizes the glow has vanished after the strike.
periods.aftermath: At home, Bell asks Hestia about the phenomenon; Hestia interprets the skill as a charged heroic strike that reverses hopeless situations.
casualties: one elf adventurer knocked unconscious by the dragon
periods.significance: This is the first observed activation of Bell's Argonaut skill and demonstrates that it can greatly amplify an active attack such as Firebolt.
